question: When frame 38 is rendered repeatedly without changing frame or scene inside one initialized Blender process, can one PID switch between the two decoded RGB modes established by B27?

evidenceBasis.b27Observation: B27 produced only two decoded RGB hashes across 24 fresh processes; both modes occurred in HISTORY and DIRECT, and the alternate mode was decoded-pixel equal to B25-A frame 38.

design.type: twelve fresh persistent processes with repeated same-frame render calls
design.frameSetRule: Set frame 38 once before the first render. Do not change scene frame or reload the blend between the twelve calls.
design.renderRule: Call bpy.ops.render.render(write_still=True) twelve times and write render-01.png through render-12.png.

primaryEndpoint.name: withinPidKnownModeSwitch
primaryEndpoint.definition: A PID switches when its twelve decoded RGB hashes include both frozen REFERENCE and ALTERNATE modes.
primaryEndpoint.whyTwo: Require recurrence in at least two independent PIDs before promoting per-render switching support.
primaryEndpoint.novelModeRule: Any decoded RGB hash outside the two frozen modes is preserved and takes the MODE_SPACE_EXPANDED decision; it is not silently coerced to either known mode.

secondaryEndpoints: adjacent mode-transition count and direction by PID
first-render mode compared descriptively with B27 DIRECT
container SHA and render time for every call
number and frequency of novel decoded RGB hashes

decisionRule.MODE_SPACE_EXPANDED: The valid experiment observes one or more decoded RGB hashes outside the two frozen modes.
decisionRule.WITHIN_PID_MODE_SWITCH_SUPPORT: No novel modes occur and at least two unique PIDs contain both frozen known modes.
decisionRule.SINGLE_PID_SWITCH_INCONCLUSIVE: No novel modes occur and exactly one PID contains both known modes.
decisionRule.PROCESS_LOCK_SUPPORT: No PID switches, no novel modes occur, and each known mode is locked within at least two distinct PIDs.
decisionRule.BETWEEN_PID_SPLIT_INCONCLUSIVE: No PID switches or novel modes occur, both known modes occur, but at least one mode appears in fewer than two PIDs.
decisionRule.MODE_NOT_REPRODUCED: No PID switches or novel modes occur and only one frozen mode appears across all 144 renders.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any identity, source, control, process, call-order, output, layout, classification, binding, decision-contract or attack gate fails.

requiredNegativeCases: REFERENCE anchor container or decoded RGB mismatch
ALTERNATE anchor container or decoded RGB mismatch
source state or fixed control mismatch
PID uniqueness or process binding mismatch
classification, manifest or file-hash binding mismatch
known-mode, sample-size, switch-threshold or decision-rule mutation
explicitNonClaims: Within-PID switching would locate recurrence at the render-invocation boundary or below; it would not identify a specific Eevee, Metal, rasterization, TAA or GPU-scheduling mechanism.
Process-lock support would not prove all initialization state is deterministic or generalize beyond this frame, scene, build, backend and machine.
The two known modes came from B27 post-hoc localization but are frozen before B28; a novel mode is valid evidence, not an invalid sample.
Twelve processes by twelve calls is a fixed mechanistic probe, not a population probability estimate or equivalence study.
Decoded RGB identity and mode switching do not determine visibility, temporal perception or cinematic quality.
PNG8 review output is not the EXR master, and human review remains a separate PENDING gate.
